title: Tutorial 13 : Pytorch - Training the Model
channel: NPTEL - Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru
description: Comprehensive tutorial on building end-to-end training and inference loops in PyTorch for classification problems, covering hyperparameters, optimizers, gradient zeroing, validation protocols, and model serialization.
instructor: Teaching Assistant / Prof. Prathosh A P

topics.title: Training Mechanics & Optimization Foundations: Forward Pass, Empirical Risk, Iterations vs. Epochs
topics.summary: Establishes supervised empirical risk minimization, contrasting full-dataset risk against stochastic mini-batch estimators and formalizing the mathematical distinction between iterations and epochs.

topics.title: Hyperparameters, Optimization Landscape & Architectural Design: Learning Rates, Adaptive Optimizers (SGD, RMSProp, Adam)
topics.summary: Examines hyperparameter sensitivities focusing on learning rate tuning, and derives adaptive moment estimation mechanics in Adam and RMSProp compared to vanilla stochastic gradient descent.

topics.title: Data Ingestion & Batching Mechanics: Shuffling, I.I.D. Sampling, Batch Invariance & Device Placement
topics.summary: Covers DataLoader configuration, random dataset permutations for I.I.D. mini-batch sampling, and explicit tensor collocation in accelerator memory via .to(device).

topics.title: The Core Training Loop: zero_grad, Gradient Accumulation Prevention, Backward Pass, and Parameter Updates
topics.summary: Implements the canonical 5-step training cycle, analyzing gradient accumulation mechanics in param.grad, the critical role of zero_grad, and in-place parameter updates.

topics.title: Evaluation & Validation Protocols: model.eval(), torch.no_grad(), Relational Accuracy & Scalar Memory Management
topics.summary: Details evaluation protocols, distinguishing model.eval() layer mode toggling from torch.no_grad() autograd suppression, computing classification accuracy, and preventing memory leaks via loss.item().

topics.title: Multi-Epoch Convergence Dynamics, Loss Fluctuations, and Model Serialization (state_dict vs Full Graph)
topics.summary: Tracks multi-epoch training convergence trajectories, explains stochastic mini-batch loss fluctuations, and demonstrates secure model serialization using model.state_dict().
